title: Humanity's Most Dangerous Delusion About AI Is Us
author: Mike Brooks Ph.D.
summary: For decades, we've told ourselves stories about creations we couldn't control. One of those cautionary tales just became our reality. The lesson isn't about AI - it's about us.

images.alt: Humanity's Most Dangerous Delusion About AI Is Us
images.caption: Cover Image

images.alt: Our biology as homo sapiens is largely unchanged. Human institutions, norms, and moral development advance gradually. Technology advances exponentially. The widening gap between these lines is what I call the accelerating evolutionary mismatch - and it's why we keep telling ourselves cautionary tales we're unable to see.

# Humanity's Most Dangerous Delusion About AI Is Us

> For decades, we've told ourselves stories about creations we couldn't control. One of those cautionary tales just became our reality. The lesson isn't about AI - it's about us.
